purpose: Teach: デュアル/ダイアログ/コンパイル/アンカー/グリッド/シールド/レビューア/コストパフォーマンス
target_vocab: コストパフォーマンス

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、実験室でデュアル測定を採用しろ
lines.en: Ren — implement dual measurement in the lab.
lines.style: Direct but not harsh. Measured pace. Assumes competence. Brief authority that expects compliance without doubt. Eye contact steady.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文中のダイアログ部分を整理します
lines.en: Yes. I'll organize the dialogue section in the paper.
lines.style: Respectful, focused nod in the voice. Quick acceptance without hesitation. Slight lean-in — eager to show he's understood. Clean, efficient delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、解析プログラムのコンパイルを最適化しろ
lines.en: Ren — optimize the compilation of the analysis program.
lines.style: Same measured authority as before. Slightly slower on the technical term, ensuring clarity. Not a request — an assignment. Confident he'll execute.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会発表でアンカー、つまり司会の役を担います
lines.en: Yes. I'll take on the moderator role for the conference presentation.
lines.style: Acceptance with underlying nervousness hidden just below. Careful enunciation on the bigger responsibility. Swallow slightly before the commitment. Steady underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、地理データのグリッド分割を整えろ
lines.en: Ren — organize the grid divisions for the geographic data.
lines.style: Same tempo as the other directives. Crisp, clear. Not questioning — stating what needs to happen. The weight of expectation delivered flatly, which makes it heavier.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験装置のシールド処理を確認します
lines.en: Yes. I'll verify the shielding on the experimental equipment.
lines.style: Affirming but quieter now, slightly fatigued beneath the politeness. Conscientious — he's tracking multiple tasks. Small breath before the final phrase. Still reliable.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の査読を国際レビューア、つまり評価者に依頼しろ
lines.en: Ren — request the paper review from international reviewers.
lines.style: Tone flattens slightly — this is the bigger ask. Still composed, but a beat longer on 'international' — he knows this is important. Authority without theatrics.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費のコストパフォーマンスを向上します
lines.en: Yes. I'll improve the cost-performance ratio of the research budget.
lines.style: Quiet determination now. The final affirmation. Slower, more thoughtful — he's internalizing the full weight of what's being asked. Small exhale at the end, but resolved.
